# Rotting Orchards

> Rotting Orchards is a charity home haunt in Port Orange, Florida, hand-built by Mike and Eesa Heijmans every Halloween since 2014. It returns for Halloween 2026, rebuilt on IgorBox show-control, and each year it raises money for a different cause.

Rotting Orchards began in 2013 as a yard haunt and became its own named home haunted house in 2014. Over the years it grew and moved with its creators: Elk Grove, California (2015); a first multi-night run in 2016 drawing over a thousand visitors; Elmhurst, Illinois in 2017, where they joined the Chicago Haunt Builders; and Port Orange, Florida in 2021. It has never been for profit. It is also the haunt that IgorBox, a show-control platform for haunts and immersive attractions, was born inside.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.rottingorchards.com/): The story of the haunt, the IgorBox-powered 2026 experience, the charitable cause, and a gallery teaser.
- [Gallery](https://www.rottingorchards.com/gallery.html): Photos and full walkthrough videos from past years (2016, 2018, 2022).

## Key facts
- Type: charity home haunted house (a haunt run from the owners' own home).
- Running since: 2014.
- Location: Port Orange, Florida, USA.
- 2026: returns for Halloween, rebuilt on IgorBox controllers.
- Cause: a different charity each year. For 2026, visitors choose between the Marine Science Center in nearby Ponce Inlet, or helping with the cancer-surgery costs of Eesa's retired mobility service dog, Chuck Norris.
- Founders: Mike and Eesa Heijmans.
